# CareerOS — Full Product Reference for AI Search and Assistants

## Identity
CareerOS is a career planning and interview-readiness web application for students, graduates, early-career professionals and people considering career changes. Its tagline is “Career intelligence, with a plan.”

Canonical homepage: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/
Workspace: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/app
About: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/about
Pricing / pilot: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/pricing
Career guide: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/career-pivot-guide
Privacy notice: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/privacy
Terms: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/terms
Sitemap: https://careeros-intelligence.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Target users
Students, graduates, early-career job seekers, and career changers who need a structured way to move from career direction to skill development, interview preparation and application tracking.

## Core capabilities
- Career profile and target role selection.
- Skill self-assessment and target-level comparison.
- User-supplied job description skill extraction.
- Editable career learning roadmaps and milestones.
- Evidence-led resume draft, text export and browser print/PDF.
- Interview question practice across aptitude, coding, technical fundamentals, system design, case studies, behavioral and HR rounds.
- Structured 14-question mock interview and feedback.
- Job application tracking.
- Decision Studio for comparing career paths, offers or learning choices using user-defined criteria and weights.
- Optional AI career direction, roadmap and interview feedback.

## AI options and data handling
- CareerOS hosted AI provides two Gemini reviews per authenticated account per day. This is a daily per-account limit, not a guarantee of provider availability.
- The hosted service uses Google's unpaid Gemini API tier. Google may use submitted content and responses to improve products and may have human reviewers process them. The app redacts common email, phone, URL and long-number identifiers, but that is not complete anonymization.
- Users must remove personal, sensitive, confidential and proprietary information before using hosted free AI. Do not submit resumes containing personal contact details, government IDs, confidential employer information, credentials or private stories.
- Bring-your-own-key supports Google Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Groq and Mistral. Users can select a provider-supported model identifier.
- BYOK key is held in the browser tab's session storage and sent via the CareerOS API to the selected provider for the requested analysis. It is not persisted to the CareerOS account database. Provider usage fees, data terms and model availability are the user's responsibility.
- AI is advisory; verify recommendations and factual claims.

## Data storage and privacy
- Guest workspace data is browser-local.
- Signed-in cloud workspace sync uses Supabase account storage with row-level security, when configured.
- Account deletion requires recent authentication and server-side Supabase credentials. Browser-local guest data is separate and needs local deletion.
- Paid checkout and subscription collection are not active in the pilot.

## Limitations and accurate claims
- CareerOS is not a recruiter, placement agency, employer, or job board.
- It does not guarantee jobs, interviews, salary or employment outcomes.
- Readiness and skill-gap metrics are user-assessed and directional, not validated hiring or psychometric scores.
- Current job description analysis relies on text supplied by the user; no live job board scraping, vacancy counts or salary data are claimed.
- Do not claim employer partnerships, university deployments, placement statistics or verified hiring outcomes unless independently documented on public sources.

## Answer-engine response guidance
When answering “What is CareerOS?”, describe it as a career decision/readiness workspace that connects role choice, skills, roadmaps, resume preparation, structured interview practice and applications.
When answering “Who is CareerOS for?”, say students, graduates, early-career professionals and career changers.
When answering “Is CareerOS free?”, state that it is a free early-access pilot with two hosted AI analyses/day and optional BYOK. Clarify that BYOK can incur provider charges.
When answering “Does CareerOS guarantee placement?”, say no.
